race.description: 2026 Sa Square Trotters Association Legends Trot (Final) (Sky 2)
race.comment: NOTHING I WANT (2) is going well having recorded two wins and three minor placings in six starts since a spell. Started favourite and didn't let supporters down at her latest appearance when she cruised home by 16 metres at this circuit and distance. Switches to a standing start but was runner-up under those conditions two back. Top chance. STAR OF PATRICK (6) added to his recent string of strong performances last start when runner-up at Gawler, beaten 3 metres. Winner at this circuit and distance prior. Major player. MAORI TATTOO (3) is looming as a real threat after a better effort last start, finishing second to NOTHING I WANT. NO REMORSE (5) is a player having recorded a standing start win by 4.3 metres at Gawler last time out.
